faq.question: What is an Agent Skill and how does it integrate with Claude or ChatGPT?
faq.answer: An Agent Skill is a standardized open package containing instructions, workflows, and templates that AI assistants use to perform specialized tasks. You download the ZIP package from our Releases page and upload it in Claude (Customize → Skills) or ChatGPT (Explore GPTs → Create a GPT). Once installed, typing `/movie-recap-studio` or asking the assistant to analyze an SRT file instantly launches the full recap production workflow.

faq.question: Do I need the companion desktop or mobile app to use the Agent Skill?
faq.answer: No. The AI Agent Skill is completely standalone. It parses subtitles, writes viral narration, and calculates timestamp cutting ranges directly inside your AI chat. You can manually use those timestamp ranges in any video editor like Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut. However, using the companion Movie Recap Windows or Android app automates the cutting and silence removal in one click.

faq.question: How does Movie Recap Studio protect my channel from YouTube copyright claims?
faq.answer: Movie recaps fall under Fair Use when they are transformational commentary. Movie Recap Studio ensures compliance by: (1) Replacing all original movie audio with your original TTS narration, (2) Generating rapid scene changes that avoid long continuous clips, and (3) Writing analytical, story-driven commentary rather than raw script reproduction.

faq.question: How does the auto silence removal (>0.3s) work?
faq.answer: High-retention video requires fast, energetic pacing. Most TTS engines leave natural 0.5s–1.0s breath pauses between sentences. The Movie Recap companion app scans your TTS audio file, identifies any silence longer than 0.3 seconds, and ripples the timeline to eliminate dead air while keeping video scene transitions perfectly synchronized.

faq.question: Is Movie Recap Studio really 100% free?
faq.answer: Yes! The core Agent Skill and companion editing applications are released under the MIT Open Source License. There are no monthly subscriptions, hidden tokens, or watermarks. You can build a 7-figure YouTube channel using these tools without paying us a penny.

faq.question: What languages and narration styles are supported?
faq.answer: The AI Skill natively crafts narration in English and Hindi/Urdu (romanized Latin script). It can adapt the emotional tone to suspense thriller, comedy, emotional drama, horror, or fast-paced action based on your channel's unique voice.

faq.question: What video and subtitle file formats are supported?
faq.answer: The AI Skill works with standard SubRip (`.srt`) files in UTF-8 or ANSI encoding. The Windows and Android companion apps support all common video containers including MP4, MKV, MOV, and WebM, encoded with H.264 (AVC), H.265 (HEVC), VP9, and AV1.

faq.question: Can I produce vertical 9:16 videos for YouTube Shorts and TikTok?
faq.answer: Yes! Both the skill and the companion applications feature dedicated 9:16 vertical modes. The skill crafts punchy 60-second scripts with immediate hooks, and the companion apps offer 9:16 center-cut and blurred background pillar-box presets.
